qc.label_under_test: Weak, diffuse pole: ordinary function words (to, the, for, with, more) inside running multi-sentence science-news or research-explainer prose (astronomy, physics, devices, cell biology); near silent in single short sentences, recipes and instructions, fiction, chat, politics, history, code.

neighbours.label: Small function words ('to', 'more', 'for', 'the') in sentences about physics, astronomy and earth science (gravitational waves, neutrinos, hydrogen gas, moons, volcanoes), even in a single sentence; weaker in biology and engineering prose, near silent in history, politics, fiction, chat and recipes
